title: content/recipes.yaml — craft recipes (FINAL slot/alternative model, D3/D4/D10)
description: The recipe catalog (Materials & Crafting plan §0 'Recipe model — FINAL'). A recipe is DATA, not a hand-drawn plan: Craft is ONE atomic action (D3) parameterized by a recipe bound at plan time; the planner chains gather→craft itself (never authored). Craft has NO tool/station action tag — the gate is purely 'inputs present + ambient in range'. A recipe is { id, inputs[], ambient[], duration, basis_stat, outputs[] }. `inputs[]` is an ordered list of SLOTS; each slot `{ any: [alternative,…] }` is satisfied by EXACTLY ONE alternative (OR). An alternative `{ tagQuery (AND), amount, mode: wear|consume }`: `consume` removes `amount` matching items/units (most-decayed-first, ties by ObjectID; works on stackable lots AND a whole durable instance); `wear` requires the matched item carry a `tool` block, decrements its current durability by `amount`, breaks (object-mortality) at 0, else persists. `ambient[]` = station tags the actor must be in range of (substitutable, NOT consumed, optional). `duration` = per-recipe craft ticks. `basis_stat` = the StatID whose roll drives success/qty AND the produced instance's durability/quality (a produced tool's start durability = roll·wear_max). Determinism (D12): a slot takes the FIRST satisfiable alternative in authored order; `wear` picks the most-worn matching tool (ties by ID); `consume` takes the most-decayed lots (ties by ID). platform/config cross-checks: every output `item` is a known item_kind; every alternative `tagQuery` tag is carried by >=1 item_kind; every `wear` alternative's tagQuery is satisfiable ONLY by item_kinds with a `tool` block; every `ambient` tag is carried by >=1 object_kind; `basis_stat` is a known StatID (D10).

recipes.description: The recipe table. An empty array = no craftables (outcome-neutral introduction). Order is NOT significant (recipes are matched by satisfiability, deterministically by sorted recipe id in the planner/Craft action).

tag.description: A core.Tag identifier (material tag `shaft_stock`, tool-family tag `tool:cutting`, station tag `station:bench`). Cross-checked at load (D10).

tagQuery.description: A set of tags an item must carry (AND — the matched item's `tags` must be a SUPERSET of this set; D4 — any item carrying the set auto-qualifies, a new item needs no recipe edit). minItems 1.

alternative.description: One alternative way to satisfy a slot (the `any` OR list, authored order = priority): match an item carrying `tagQuery`, at `amount`, used by `mode`. `consume` removes `amount` (most-decayed lots first, ties by ObjectID; works on stackable lots AND a whole durable instance — a tool consumed AS material, e.g. an old knife reforged). `wear` requires the matched item carry a `tool` block; it decrements current durability by `amount` and breaks (object-mortality) at 0, else persists (picks the most-worn matching tool, ties by ID).

amount.description: consume: count of matching items/units removed. wear: durability points decremented from the matched tool. Integer >= 1.

mode.description: `consume` — remove `amount` matching items/units (most-decayed-first, ties by ObjectID; stackable lots OR a whole durable instance). `wear` — the matched item MUST have a `tool` block; decrement its current durability by `amount`, break/remove at 0, else persist (most-worn matching tool, ties by ID).

slot.description: One ordered input slot, satisfied by EXACTLY ONE of its `any` alternatives (OR). The planner/world takes the FIRST satisfiable alternative in authored order (D12).

any.description: The OR list of alternatives (authored order = priority). minItems 1 (a single-alternative slot is just a required input; multiple alternatives = substitutable 2단 대체, possibly with different amount/mode).

output.description: One produced item at a BASE quantity. Actual success/qty AND the produced instance's durability/quality are ROLLED from the recipe's `basis_stat` (skilled -> sturdier/more) — `base_qty` is the pre-roll base. A produced tool's starting durability = roll·`wear_max`. A perishable output is placed as a fresh decay lot {kind, qty, decayAge=0} (Dm5).

base_qty.description: Base produced quantity before the basis_stat roll (integer >= 1).

inputs.description: Ordered list of SLOTS (each `{ any: [alternative,…] }`). minItems 1 — a recipe consumes/uses something. The craftable gate: every slot has a satisfiable alternative (no partial run).

ambient.description: Station tags (주변도구: bench/furnace…) the actor must be IN RANGE of an object carrying (each tag; substitutable — any object carrying the tag). NOT consumed. Optional (a recipe with no ambient needs no station). The Craft action binds the in-range objects via the spatial hash; there is NO action `target_tags` (FINAL).

duration.description: Per-recipe craft time in ticks (FINAL — replaces the Cm6 action-flat duration). Integer >= 1; the engine may scale it by the basis_stat at execution.

basis_stat.description: The StatID whose roll drives the outcome (success, qty, AND the produced instance's durability/quality — produced tool start durability = roll·wear_max). Must be a known StatID (D10; e.g. Dexterity).

outputs.description: Produced items (item + base_qty each). minItems 1 — a recipe produces something.
